name: Urbano Market
description: Online general-merchandise retailer in Uruguay on Shopify. Sells decoration and lighting, school and office supplies, home and kitchen goods, children's products and toys, watches and thermoses. States shipping across Uruguay mainly through DAC, free above a stated threshold.

Indica envíos a todo el país principalmente por DAC, gratis por encima de un monto indicado.
